prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses prior to the one in which this subject is placed.

learning_outcomes.text: To know the bases of the resistant behavior of structural concrete. Knowledge of the fundamentals of design and calculation of concrete structures.

To understand the criteria on which concrete structure regulations are based, to manage and apply them. To achieve adequate practical proficiency in the dimensioning and verification of main concrete structural elements.

syllabus_topics: Concrete components: aggregates, cement, water, admixtures, additions
Concrete as a material. Mass, reinforced and prestressed concrete
Design and dimensioning of columns. Longitudinal reinforcement
Design and dimensioning of ribs, beams and slabs. Longitudinal reinforcement
Design and calculation of elements subjected to shear forces. Transverse reinforcement. Strut-and-tie method.
Design, dimensioning and verification of concrete structural elements. Application of regulations. Short corbels
assessment_rules: Students scoring 45% or more on the sum of exam tests receive an additional 0.5 points if they attended and participated in all practices and submitted requested documentation. An additional 0.5 points (total 1 point for practices) are awarded if they also submit all proposed homework problems. Students scoring 40% or more on the sum of exam tests will have their project grade added. A minimum of 35% of the maximum score is required for both the objective question exam and the development question exam to pass the course. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a failing grade (0.0) for the academic year.
